findings: The C program emits twelve fixed rows and executes no reference transition or release algorithm.
The harness still handwrites ABI types, constants, list helpers and offset_of; the standalone Rust fixture defines a different type and is neither appended nor executed.
Source reuse through actual begin/enqueue/finish, both mixed-destination cases, two-head isolation, complete metadata preservation and required trait negatives are missing or mislabeled.
The mutant bypasses detach validation and does not release a valid prefix before discovering the later-invalid node.
Wrong-source recovery is unfinished and the callback ledger lacks checked RefCell borrowing and a callback-safe capacity bound.
The no-argument entrypoint attempts to create an already-created temporary directory.
Commands, return codes, compiler identities and complete input/artifact hashes are not retained.

source_review_observation: The production drain implementation performs complete validation before its first callback under its unsafe exclusivity contract.
